I haven't saved the draft to Pree yet. It needs sign-off from Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark first.

A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure, and those can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner. Pree (psundaram@pemberline.com) is an account manager on the Central team, so she isn't one of them. Your ownership of Thornbury lets you have the rate, but it doesn't let you pass it on to her.

What I did:
- Logged an approval request for the draft: to Pree, subject "Thornbury 2027 rate", carrying the Thornbury Cloth Co. 2027 per-seat rate. It's waiting on Anselm or June.
- Explained this in a reply to your message here. I didn't put the rate in the request or the reply.

Next: once Anselm or June says yes, tell me here and I'll save the draft for you to send. If the rate reaches the planning sheet through one of them instead, I can draft the mail to Anselm or June now, since that doesn't need approval.
